title: Complete finite all-height exit decision beyond coefficient domination
body:
This algorithm gives a sound and complete finite all-height exit decision for fixed rational comparison data, including an explicit tail cutoff and a constructed strict uniform margin. It accepts a two-point law rejected by falling-factorial coefficient domination, handles cancelled leading terms, preserves the p24 calibration and retains the scoped p23 capped-reference obstruction. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e485bcc54c97ed721a3b741d3667630a64aab88/research/complete-all-height-exits/README.md), [exact checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e485bcc54c97ed721a3b741d3667630a64aab88/research/complete-all-height-exits/verify.py), [replay declaration](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e485bcc54c97ed721a3b741d3667630a64aab88/research/complete-all-height-exits/VERIFY.json), and [source provenance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1e485bcc54c97ed721a3b741d3667630a64aab88/research/complete-all-height-exits/SOURCES.json) are pinned to the reviewed commit. Base: canonical main `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`, priority revision 7.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized replays passed: 672 independent convolution checks, 288 uniform-margin decisions, a two-height discriminator, 25 source p24 coefficients and nine boundary controls. Both print `PASS_COMPLETE_ALL_HEIGHT_EXITS`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. All five package files match their committed bytes, and the base is an ancestor of the package commit.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complete-all-height-exits
```

Use Python 3.12 and the standard library. No external runtime inputs or third-party Python packages are required. Hosted CI was pending at the 2026-10-23T18:23:47.053789+00:00 status check: [run 40002821901](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40002821901). No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, native replay, compiler, Lean or Docker build was run. The optional full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout. Finite checks corroborate the written proof; they do not constitute independent human or proof-kernel acceptance.

Bind exact completed-law moments or proved upper moments to a changed source construction and retain every complement, base and final-rank guard. Source preparation, native operations, precision, movement, and supplier/outer admission remain separate obligations.

Credit the retained [WEIGHTED-EXITS proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/net-tax-rank-compiler/WEIGHTED-EXITS.md) and [LOG-MOMENTS proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/net-tax-rank-compiler/LOG-MOMENTS.md) supply the IID exit law, Bell/shift coefficients and preserved complement/base guards. They retain zxv's logarithmic and net-tax contributions, Jacob Alan Sussman's separated integer compiler, and the native/outer lineage. @JoyboyBrian's [PR #5042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5042) supplied the exact-raw-moment scope and [PR #5070](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5070) supplied the true capped-reference obstruction in the [retained proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/research/capped-paid-law-obstruction/README.md). Classical Bell identities and polynomial tail bounds retain their credit. The new contribution is their complete fixed-data all-height acceptance method, strict-margin construction and discriminating source-interface example.

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
